property_summary: After any call to the fallback function with exactly 10 ether, pastBlockTime is strictly greater than before the call.
After any two consecutive calls to the fallback function with 10 ether, pastBlockTime strictly increases.
After any call to the fallback function with exactly 10 ether, pastBlockTime is strictly greater than before the call.
pastBlockTime must strictly increase after each call to fallback
The contract’s balance never decreases when pastBlockTime increases.
After a fallback call that modifies pastBlockTime, the contract's balance remains unchanged if the block number is not divisible by 15.
The contract's balance never decreases by exactly 10 ether when msg.value is 5 ether.
After a successful fallback call, the contract's balance is always at least the original balance minus 10 ether when the call is made at a block number divisible by 15.
The contract should always revert when msg.value is not exactly 10 ether.
After any sequence of calls that ends with a successful fallback call, the contract's ether balance is always zero when block.number % 15 == 0.
